name: Hot in a Flash, or Cold Just as Fast?
description: It is said that Lepine-Pauline has developed a groundbreaking new lens. But why does her apprentice Ninette look on the verge of tears?

dialogs.content: (...Could they be the ones Master mentioned? The golden-haired traveler, and that flying fairy dressed in white...)
Huh? Why are you staring at us and muttering like that? Is there something weird on our faces?
Ah! M—My apologies! I didn't mean to! I just... I just thought...
There's no rush. Please, take your time.
#I... I'm Ninette, and my master is Lepine-Pauline. She told me about you... said you're the legendary adventurer {NICKNAME}, and that you travel with your best companion, Paimon!
I... I never imagined I'd really get to see you in person...
Oh! So you're Lepine-Pauline's apprentice! Guess her business has really been booming lately, huh?
Yes! And it's all thanks to her that I was able to get back on my feet after a really hard time.
Did something happen?
I used to study photography under another teacher.
I wanted to make it on my own someday, so I spent all my savings on the best Kamera equipment I could afford.
My teacher said my skills weren't bad, and I really believed that if I just took good photos, I'd be able to make a living.
But... when I actually went out on the streets and saw people, I got so nervous that I couldn't get a single word out.
Every time I tried to say, "Hello, would you like a photo?", the words just got stuck in my throat.
In the end, everyone just went to the photographers who were friendlier and better at talking to people.
Before I knew it, I'd almost run out of Mora... and I even thought about selling my Kamera just to get by...
That must've been really hard.
It was right then that I met Master Lepine-Pauline.
When she saw my equipment and the photos I'd taken, she encouraged me and had me work with her to test a new lens.
She said there was a calm, gentle quality in my photos... something she didn't see in anyone else's.
So when Master finally finished developing the Shutterflash lens, I was really happy! Probably even more than she was!
The Shutterflash lens? What kind of lens is that?
It captures every movement and expression perfectly, even when the subject's moving really fast!
But... it's still in the final testing phase, so we need to take a lot of real-world photos to gather data and make sure it works properly.
Since Master's been tied up with other work, she handed this task to me. I was thinking I could try finding a few people to help with the testing...
But... it happened again. Whenever I tried to talk to someone I didn't know, I got all flustered and couldn't make any sense...
Everyone just looked at me kind of confused... they probably thought I was acting suspicious or something. A few days went by, and I still couldn't find anyone willing to help.
*sobbing*... I couldn't even handle something this easy... I guess I really am hopeless...
Hey, hey, don't cry! It's really not your fault, okay?
Really, asking strangers for help like that is hard for anyone!
Don't beat yourself up over it. You've already tried your best.
#Uh-huh! {NICKNAME}'s got great photo skills! And {M#he}{F#she} knows tons of people all over the place, so getting models should be super easy!
R—Really? You'd actually help me?
#W—Whoa! Thank you so, so much, {NICKNAME}!
Then... please take this special Kamera with the Shutterflash lens. I'll be counting on you to handle it!
Please take some photos of your friends. Try to capture their most natural, expressive moments!
In that case... maybe we could lend a hand.
Do I know you?
